title: What YOU Taught Me About Hope | Slow English Listening

header.titleZh: 關於希望，你教我什麼？慢速英語聽力
header.titleEn: What YOU Taught Me About Hope | Slow English Listening

sentences.en: Let's talk.
sentences.tc: 我們來談談吧。

englishTokens.text: Let's talk.

sentences.en: I've been thinking about hope lately.
sentences.tc: 我最近一直在思考希望。

englishTokens.text: I've been thinking about hope
lately

sentences.en: How powerful hope is.
sentences.tc: 希望是多麼強大。

englishTokens.text: How powerful hope is.

sentences.en: Hope can change the world.
sentences.tc: 希望可以改變世界。

englishTokens.text: Hope can change the world.

sentences.en: Hope is in the music we listen to, the songs we sing together, the meals we eat that warm our hearts, the laughs we share with strangers and loved ones.
sentences.tc: 希望存在于我們聽的音樂、我們一起唱的歌曲、我們吃的温暖我們心的飯菜、我們與陌生人和親人分享的笑聲中。

englishTokens.text: Hope is in the music we listen to, the songs we sing together, the meals we eat that warm our hearts, the laughs we share with strangers and loved ones.

sentences.en: I think laughter heals our soul.
sentences.tc: 我認為笑聲可以治愈我們的靈魂。

englishTokens.text: I think
laughter
heals our
soul

sentences.en: Hope is in the flower that SOMEHOW is growing straight through a crack in the sidewalk.
sentences.tc: 希望之花不知何故从人行道的裂縫中直生長出來。

englishTokens.text: Hope is in the flower that
SOMEHOW
is growing straight through a crack in the sidewalk.

sentences.en: It's in the sun that continues to show up without missing a day.
sentences.tc: 它在陽光下持續出現，一天也不缺席。

englishTokens.text: It's in the sun that continues to show up without missing a day.

sentences.en: It's in the rain that comes just when you need it the most.
sentences.tc: 正是在你最需要的时候下雨了。

englishTokens.text: It's in the rain that comes just when you need it the most.

sentences.en: It's in the stranger that smiles at you walking down the street.
sentences.tc: 走在街上的陌生人對你微笑。

englishTokens.text: It's in the stranger that smiles at you walking down the street.

sentences.en: We can find hope in the poetry that inspires us, the paintings that represent us, and the clothing that helps us express ourselves.
sentences.tc: 我們可以在激勵我們的诗歌、代表我們的绘畫以及幫助我​​們表達自己的服装中找到希望。

englishTokens.text: We can find hope in the poetry that inspires us, the paintings that represent us, and the clothing that helps us express ourselves.

sentences.en: I feel hopeful when I see a flock of birds in the sky or when a butterfly lands in front of me.
sentences.tc: 當我看到天空中的一群鸟或一只蝴蝶降落在我面前时，我感到充滿希望。

englishTokens.text: I
feel
hopeful when I see a flock of birds in the sky or when a butterfly lands in front of me.

sentences.en: I feel hopeful when my favorite song comes on just when I need it.
sentences.tc: 當我最喜歡的歌曲在我需要的时候響起时，我感到充滿希望。

englishTokens.text: I
feel
hopeful when my favorite song comes on just when I need it.

sentences.en: When I dance of joy in my room or when I experience something for the first time ever.
sentences.tc: 當我在房間里歡快地跳舞时，或者當我第一次經历某些事情时。

englishTokens.text: When I dance of joy in my room or when I experience something for the first time ever.

sentences.en: Whether that's a new skill, a new song, a new person, a new feeling, good or bad.
sentences.tc: 無论這是一项新技能、一首新歌、一個新人、一種新感覺，好还是坏。

englishTokens.text: Whether that's a new skill, a new song, a new person, a new feeling, good or bad.

sentences.en: When you feel like all hope is lost, dance, sing, observe, appreciate, learn, express and love.
sentences.tc: 當你感覺所有希望都破灭时，跳舞、唱歌、觀察、欣赏、學習、表達和愛。

englishTokens.text: When you
feel
like all hope is lost, dance, sing, observe, appreciate, learn, express and love.

sentences.en: In my experience, hope is the only way.
sentences.tc: 根據我的經驗，希望是唯一的出路。

englishTokens.text: In my experience, hope is the only way.

sentences.en: And you guys have given me hope in the darkest of days.
sentences.tc: 你們在最黑暗的日子里给了我希望。

englishTokens.text: And you guys
have
given me hope in the darkest of days.

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.tc: 谢谢。

englishTokens.text: Thank you.

sentences.en: What is hope to you?
sentences.tc: 對你來說希望是什麼？

englishTokens.text: What is hope to you?

sentences.en: What brings you hope?
sentences.tc: 是什麼给你帶來了希望？

englishTokens.text: What brings you hope?

sentences.en: I hope you have the best day today.
sentences.tc: 我希望你今天過得很愉快。

englishTokens.text: I hope you
have
the best day today.

sentences.en: I hope you find one thing to be grateful for today.
sentences.tc: 我希望你今天能找到一件值得感激的事情。

englishTokens.text: I hope you find one thing to be
grateful
for today.

sentences.en: I hope the sun comes out today.
sentences.tc: 我希望今天太陽出來了。

englishTokens.text: I hope the sun comes out today.

sentences.en: I hope you eat something delicious today.
sentences.tc: 希望你今天吃点好吃的。

englishTokens.text: I hope you eat something
delicious
today.

sentences.en: I hope you love something today.
sentences.tc: 我希望你今天喜歡一些东西。

englishTokens.text: I hope you love something today.

sentences.en: And I hope something loves you today.
sentences.tc: 我希望今天有人愛你。

englishTokens.text: And I hope something loves you today.

sentences.en: I hope you are safe today.
sentences.tc: 希望你今天平安。

englishTokens.text: I hope you are safe today.

sentences.en: I know hope is something that feels scarce today.
sentences.tc: 我知道今天感覺希望是稀缺的东西。

englishTokens.text: I know hope is something that feels scarce today.

sentences.en: There is so much pain and conflict in the world.
sentences.tc: 世界上有如此多的痛苦和冲突。

englishTokens.text: There is so much pain and conflict in the world.

sentences.en: But hope is something that nobody can take from us.
sentences.tc: 但希望是任何人都無法从我們手中夺走的东西。

englishTokens.text: But hope is something that nobody can
take
from us.

sentences.en: And I hope you hold on to even the smallest piece of hope today.
sentences.tc: 我希望你今天能坚持哪怕是最小的希望。

englishTokens.text: And I hope you hold on to even the smallest piece of hope today.

sentences.en: And to all my viewers around the world, thank you for bringing me hope every day.
sentences.tc: 感谢世界各地的所有觀眾，感谢你們每天给我帶來希望。

englishTokens.text: And to all my viewers around the world, thank you for bringing me hope every day.

sentences.en: What do you hope for today?
sentences.tc: 今天你有什麼希望？

englishTokens.text: What do you hope for today?

sentences.en: What do you hope for yourself?
sentences.tc: 你對自己有什麼希望？

englishTokens.text: What do you hope for yourself?

sentences.en: And what do you hope for someone else?
sentences.tc: 你對別人有什麼希望？

englishTokens.text: And what do you hope for someone else?

sentences.en: Count how many times I said hope.
sentences.tc: 數數我說了多少次希望。

englishTokens.text: Count how many times I said hope.

sentences.en: We have just reached 1 million subscribers, and I could not be more grateful for all the hope you have given me this year.
sentences.tc: 我們的訂阅者剛剛達到100万，我非常感谢你們今年给我的所有希望。

englishTokens.text: We have just reached 1 million subscribers, and I
could not be more grateful
for all the hope you have given me this year.

sentences.en: Want is to try and do the same for you.
sentences.tc: 想要就是嘗試為你做同樣的事情。

englishTokens.text: Want is to try and do the same for you.

sentences.en: As some of you know, I have an English community where we learn together, we speak together, and we support each other.
sentences.tc: 正如你們中的一些人所知，我有一個英語社區，我們在這里一起學習、一起說话、互相支持。

englishTokens.text: As some of you know, I
have
an English community where we learn together, we speak together, and we support each other.

sentences.en: It's something really special and I know lots of you would love to be a part of it to improve your English and create more opportunities for yourself.
sentences.tc: 這是一件非常特別的事情，我知道你們很多人都愿意参與其中，以提高英語水平并為自己創造更多機會。

englishTokens.text: It's something really special and I know lots of you would love to be a part of it to improve your English and create more opportunities for yourself.

sentences.en: But I also know that for many of you, life isn't easy right now.
sentences.tc: 但我也知道，對于你們中的许多人來說，現在的生活并不輕松。

englishTokens.text: But I also know that for many of you, life isn't easy right now.

sentences.en: And sometimes it's just not something you can afford.
sentences.tc: 有时這不是你能负担得起的。

englishTokens.text: And sometimes it's just not something you can afford.

sentences.en: So, I'm opening 10 free spots in my community for people who are going through difficult for viewers that are going through difficult situations.
sentences.tc: 因此，我在社區中為正在經历困難的人們和正在經历困難情况的觀眾開放10個免費点。

englishTokens.text: So, I'm opening 10 free spots in my community for people who are going through difficult for viewers that are going through difficult situations.

sentences.en: Wherever you are, there's a link below where you can apply.
sentences.tc: 無论您身在何處，下面都有一個链接可供您申請。

englishTokens.text: Wherever you are, there's a link below where you can apply.

sentences.en: I'll be reading your answers and selecting a group of people who are truly ready for this.
sentences.tc: 我将阅讀您的答案并選擇一组真正為此做好准備的人。

englishTokens.text: I'll be reading your answers and selecting a group of people who are truly ready for this.

sentences.en: And from that group, 10 people will be chosen randomly.
sentences.tc: 从該组中，将随機選擇10人。

englishTokens.text: And from that group, 10 people will be chosen randomly.

sentences.en: So, please apply for this if you really need it, if you really want it, and be honest with your answers.
sentences.tc: 所以，如果你真的需要它，如果你真的想要它，請申請這個，并誠實地回答你的問题。

englishTokens.text: So, please apply for this if you really need it, if you really want it, and be honest with your answers.

sentences.en: And even if you don't get selected, everyone who enters their information will be invited to join a private live session with with all of us.
sentences.tc: 即使您沒有被選中，每個輸入信息的人都将被邀請與我們所有人一起参加私人現場會议。

englishTokens.text: And even if you don't
get
selected, everyone who enters their information will be invited to join a private live session with with all of us.

sentences.en: Only for those who applied.
sentences.tc: 仅限申請者。

englishTokens.text: Only for those who applied.

sentences.en: So no matter what, you're still a part of this.
sentences.tc: 所以無论如何，你仍然是其中的一部分。

englishTokens.text: So no matter what, you're still a part of this.

sentences.en: Application closes in 5 days.
sentences.tc: 申請将于5天內截止。

englishTokens.text: Application closes in 5 days.

sentences.en: So leave your answers.
sentences.tc: 所以請留下你的答案。

englishTokens.text: So leave your answers.

sentences.en: The link is in the description.
sentences.tc: 链接位于說明中。

englishTokens.text: The link is in the description.

sentences.en: And if you can afford my course, it's only $16 per month with the annual plan.
sentences.tc: 如果您能负担得起我的課程，包年套餐每月仅需16美元。

englishTokens.text: And if you can afford my course, it's only $16 per month with the annual plan.

sentences.en: If you're interested, today is the last day to join.
sentences.tc: 如果您有興趣，今天是加入的最後一天。

englishTokens.text: If you're interested, today is the last day to join.

sentences.en: But be sure to apply for this only if you truly need it and truly want it.
sentences.tc: 但請務必仅在您確實需要并且真正想要的情况下才申請。

englishTokens.text: But be sure to apply for this only if you truly need it and truly want it.

sentences.en: If not, then save room for those who do need it.
sentences.tc: 如果沒有，那就為那些確實需要的人留出空間。

englishTokens.text: If not, then save room for those who do need it.

sentences.en: I trust you guys.
sentences.tc: 我相信你們。

englishTokens.text: I trust you guys.

sentences.en: And thank you so much for 1 million subscribers.
sentences.tc: 非常感谢100万訂阅者。

englishTokens.text: And thank you so much for 1 million subscribers.

sentences.en: I trust the 10 spots will be given to those who truly need it.
sentences.tc: 我相信這10個名額将會给予那些真正需要的人。

englishTokens.text: I trust the 10 spots will be given to those who truly need it.

sentences.en: So, I hope this brought you hope today.
sentences.tc: 所以，我希望今天這给你帶來希望。

englishTokens.text: So, I hope this brought you hope today.

sentences.en: Thank you guys for 1 million subscribers.
sentences.tc: 感谢你們擁有100万訂阅者。

englishTokens.text: Thank you guys for 1 million subscribers.

sentences.en: I hope you learned something new today.
sentences.tc: 我希望你今天學到了一些新东西。

englishTokens.text: I hope you learned something new today.

sentences.en: And remember, never stop believing.
sentences.tc: 請记住，永遠不要停止相信。

englishTokens.text: And remember, never stop believing.

sentences.en: Nothing can beat hope.
sentences.tc: 沒有什麼能战胜希望。

englishTokens.text: Nothing can beat hope.

sentences.en: See you next week.
sentences.tc: 下周见。

englishTokens.text: See you next week.
